description:
Read a site's robots.txt and report, for each AI crawler and assistant (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended and more), whether it may crawl the site, with the deciding rule. Also requests the homepage as a few AI bots to spot firewall/CDN blocks robots.txt doesn't show, and returns paste-ready robots.txt fixes.

Billing: free.

Inputs: domain — hostname or URL.

Returns { domain, robots_txt, summary: { blocked, limited, training_blocked, unclear, likely_blocked_by_firewall, robots_unknown }, bots: [{ bot, owner, purpose, verdict, note? }], firewall_probe, llms_txt_blocked_for, fixes: [{ title, robots_txt, bots }], cached_at, since_last_check?: { previous_check_at, changed, changes: [{ item, before, now }] }, suggested_next: { tool, args, price_cents, price_label, why }, next_step }. suggested_next is the one priced step after it (relay once; run only if the user agrees). The firewall probe uses the bots' user-agents, not their IP addresses: a block there is a strong hint, not proof (caveat says so).

domain.description: Hostname or URL of the site to check.

name: check_ai_crawlers
title: Check which AI crawlers can reach a site
